title: tadu repository config, todo/tadu.json
description: Settings that are about the backlog as a whole, not one task.

tadu.description: Format version the repository is on. Task files may still carry older versions.

categories.description: Allowed task categories: slug -> display name.

types.description: Allowed task types. Default when absent: bug feature chore test docs refactor perf security.

archive.description: Optional. Absent = no archive: closed tasks stay in todo/closed/. tadu archive --write moves closed tasks that match either rule into todo/archive/, whole and unchanged.

after_days.description: Archive closed tasks whose closed date is more than this many days ago.

keep_closed.description: Keep at most this many tasks in closed/; the oldest (by closed date) beyond it are archived.

month_folders_min.description: A year of the archive is split into month folders (YYYY/MM/) only when its months would hold at least this many tasks on average (counting months that have tasks). Default 10: twelve tasks in a year stay in one folder.

milestones.description: Allowed milestones: slug -> name and optional due date.

stale_after_days.description: doctor warns when a task has been in progress longer than this (from started). Default 14.
